About the model and privacy

Soundwalk uses Google's open YAMNet sound-event model through MediaPipe. Recognition runs in your browser, including when you choose a file. Your recording is never sent to a server. Model scores are suggestions, not calibrated probabilities or bird-species IDs.

The first load needs internet to download the local model and runtime. After “Offline copy ready” appears, this page can reopen without a connection in browsers that support service workers. Private-site sign-in may still require internet. The upstream runtime documents performance metrics sent to Google. This page restricts network connections to its own origin to block those external requests. Notes remain in this browser; clearing site data removes them.

Built for the Hacktoberfest “Touch Grass” challenge. No claim of outdoor field testing. Open-source credits
